items.t: US energy rig count drops for first time in six weeks

items.t: What If the Fed Doubles the Rate Hike in December? These 5 Dividend Stocks Could Prosper
items.sum: Markets say a quarter-point hike is nearly certain, but a hot inflation print could change that fast. Five dividend payers, from banks to an oil giant to a toothpaste maker, each win in a different way if the Fed gets aggressive.
